# Libraries 
```{r}
# spatial data science
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(units)

# Data
library(AOI)

# Visualization
library(gghighlight)
library(ggrepel)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
```

# Question 1
```{r}
#1.1 
eqdc <- '+proj=eqdc +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-96 +lat_1=20 +lat_2=60 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs'

#1.2 
remotes::install_github("mikejohnson51/AOI")
states <- aoi_get(state = 'conus')
states <- st_transform(states, crs = eqdc)

#1.3 
countries <- aoi_get(country = c("MX", "CA", "USA"))
sf::st_crs(countries)
countries <- st_transform(countries, crs = eqdc)

#1.4 
library(readr)
uscities <- read_csv("data/uscities_data/uscities.csv")
uscities_sf <- st_as_sf(uscities, 
                        coords = c("lng", "lat"),  
                        crs = 4326)
# Remove cities in Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico
uscities_sf_filtered <- uscities_sf %>%
  filter(!state_name %in% c("Alaska", "Hawaii", "Puerto Rico"))
uscities_sf_filtered <- st_transform(uscities_sf_filtered, crs = eqdc)
```

# Question 2
```{r}
##2.1 Distance to U.S. Border (km0)
usa_union <- st_union(states) #Combine    
usa_border <- st_boundary(usa_union)

uscities_sf_filtered$distance_to_border_km <- st_distance(uscities_sf_filtered, usa_border) %>%
  as.numeric() / 1000 
#Five farthest cities 
farthest_cities <- uscities_sf_filtered %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_border_km)) %>%
  select(city, state_name, distance_to_border_km) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  mutate(distance_to_border_km = round(distance_to_border_km, 2))

#Table 
farthest_table_df <- farthest_cities %>%
  st_drop_geometry()
farthest_table <- flextable(farthest_table_df) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    city = "City",
    state_name = "State",
    distance_to_border_km = "Distance to Border (km)")%>%
  autofit()
print(farthest_table)

##2.2 Distance to States (km)
state_boundaries <- st_boundary(states) #combine
combined_state_lines <- st_union(state_boundaries)

#Calculate distances
uscities_sf_filtered$distance_to_sb_km <- st_distance(uscities_sf_filtered, combined_state_lines)%>%
  as.numeric() / 1000 

#Five farthest cities
farthest_cities_sb <- uscities_sf_filtered %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_sb_km)) %>%
  select(city, state_name, distance_to_sb_km) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  mutate(distance_to_sb_km = round(distance_to_sb_km, 2))

#Table
farthest_table_sb <- farthest_cities_sb %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(
    city = "City",
    state_name = "State",
    distance_to_sb_km = "Distance to State Border (km)") %>%
  autofit()
print(farthest_table_sb)

##2.3 Distance to Mexico (km)
mexico <- countries %>%
  filter(sovereignt == "Mexico")
mexico_border <- st_boundary(mexico) #distance
uscities_sf_filtered$distance_to_mexico_border_km <- st_distance(uscities_sf_filtered, mexico_border) %>%
  as.numeric() / 1000 

#Five farthest cities
farthest_cities_mexico_border <- uscities_sf_filtered %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_mexico_border_km)) %>%
  select(city, state_name, distance_to_mexico_border_km) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  mutate(distance_to_mexico_border_km = round(distance_to_mexico_border_km, 2))

#Table
farthest_table_mexico_border <- farthest_cities_mexico_border %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(
    city = "City",
    state_name = "State",
    distance_to_mexico_border_km = "Distance to Mexican Border (km)") %>%
  autofit()
print(farthest_table_mexico_border)

##2.4 Distance to Canada (km)
canada <- countries %>%
  filter(sovereignt == "Canada")
canada_border <- st_boundary(canada)
uscities_sf_filtered$distance_to_canada_border_km <- st_distance(uscities_sf_filtered, canada_border) %>%
  as.numeric() / 1000 
# Five cities
farthest_cities_canada_border <- uscities_sf_filtered %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_canada_border_km)) %>%
  select(city, state_name, distance_to_canada_border_km) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  mutate(distance_to_canada_border_km = round(distance_to_canada_border_km, 2))

# Table 
farthest_table_canada_border <- farthest_cities_canada_border %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(
    city = "City",
    state_name = "State",
    distance_to_canada_border_km = "Distance to Canadian Border (km)") %>%
  autofit()
print(farthest_table_canada_border)
```
